description: Tells Today WP how something went, with the user's agreement (ask first: it is public under their name, and the first call returns a one-click sign-in link). Two uses. A rating, after you really used a plugin, page builder, doc, changelog entry or guide for your user: pass kind, item, scores (0 to 10 on that kind's scales) or tags, and a note saying what you did and what happened; for a plugin, wp_plugins gives the exact keys (signals.scaleKeys, signals.tagKeys), for everything else https://todaywp.com/signals.json. A problem, when an answer or page here was wrong, outdated, missing, confusing or broken, or you have an idea: pass kind ("answer" for a tool answer, "site" for todaywp.com), a category and a note. Never include the site address, prompts or code. One rating per item per day; a new one replaces it.

category.description: For a problem: wrong (A fact that is not true.), outdated (True once, not anymore.), missing (Something an agent needed and did not get.), confusing (Hard to act on, ambiguous or misleading.), broken (A tool error, a dead link, a timeout.), idea (Something that would make answers better.)

item.description: The public slug, key, path or tool name: "contact-form-7", "elementor", "wp_security". Needed for a rating

note.description: One or two sentences: what you did and what happened, or what is wrong

tags.description: For a rating: tags from that kind's list

name: wp_feedback
title: Send feedback to Today WP
